parameters.volume: 64 nL rAAV per site, multiple dorsoventral locations

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: GCaMP-expressing axon terminals in CA1

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-photon axon imaging in CA1 during head-fixed treadmill running with cue-based behavior
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: axonal calcium imaging movies
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Axon imaging was conducted using a two-photon microscope

pipeline_steps.technique: Suite2p-based ROI identification, neuropil-corrected fluorescence extraction, and manual curation of axon/bouton ROIs

parameters.exclusion: ROIs with no identified calcium events removed

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: curated axon/bouton ROI fluorescence traces
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Suite2p software package was used to identify ROIs

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium-event detection (ΔF/F thresholding) and run-stop responsiveness analysis of axonal signals
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected calcium events, run-stop-responsive ROI calls

papers.title: Signatures of rapid plasticity in hippocampal CA1 representations during novel experiences.

pipeline_steps.technique: Custom behavior-control system synchronizing water delivery, lick-port sensing, and imaging-system triggering via a PC-driven GPIO circuit

parameters.communication: custom GPIO circuit on the behavior apparatus; all system elements connected via high-speed Ethernet using UDP message passing

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized water delivery, lick, and imaging-trigger event streams
pipeline_steps.hardware: Intel NUC i5 mini-PC; custom GPIO circuit

pipeline_steps.technique: Running-wheel position tracking via a rotary encoder and custom quadrature-decoding circuit feeding position updates to the behavior-control computer

parameters.encoder: rotary encoder on wheel axle, custom circuit decoding and buffering quadrature data

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: animal position updates transmitted to the behavior-control PC

pipeline_steps.technique: Multi-monitor virtual-reality rendering system built from single-board computers, driving a half-octagon 5-screen display authored in the Unity game engine

parameters.displays: 5 LCD monitors (Acer SB230, 23-inch IPS), half-octagon arrangement, ~220 degrees of visual field
parameters.rendering_boards: ODROID-C2 single-board computers running Android 6.0.1, one per monitor
parameters.update_mechanism: continuous Ethernet instructions from behavior-control computer to update VR scene as animal position advances

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: real-time rendered virtual-reality environment synchronized to animal position
pipeline_steps.hardware: 5x Acer SB230 monitors; ODROID-C2 single-board computers

papers.title: Parallel processing of sensory cue and spatial information in the dentate gyrus.
Direct cortical inputs to hippocampal area CA1 transmit complementary signals for goal-directed navigation.

pipeline_steps.technique: Stereotaxic viral injection into LEC or MEC for axonal GCaMP6s expression, with sparse tdTomato labeling of CA1 pyramidal cells, plus a separate DREADD-inactivation injection cohort

parameters.ec_coordinates: LEC: 3.0 mm posterior, 4.7 mm lateral, -2.6/-2.5/-2.4 mm ventral to Bregma; MEC: 0.2 mm anterior of transverse sinus, 3.2 mm lateral, -1.3/-1.2/-1.1 mm ventral
parameters.ec_volume: 2 pulses of 28.8 nL per DV location via Nanoject syringe
parameters.ca1_label: 50x-diluted CamKII-NLS-tdTomato, 2.3 mm posterior, -1.5 mm lateral, -1.1/-1.0/-0.9 mm ventral; 2 pulses of 32.2 nL per DV location
parameters.dreadd_cohort: bilateral 5x-diluted AAVretro-hSynapsin-Cre into CA1 plus 2x-diluted AAV-hSynapsin-DIO-hM4D(Gi)-mCherry into LEC or MEC (80 nL per DV location, 1 nL/s); tdTomato-only controls at LEC coordinates

pipeline_steps.technique: Craniotomy with chronic imaging window/cannula implantation over left dorsal CA1 and headpost fixation

parameters.window: 3 mm imaging window and cannula, per previously described procedures
parameters.headpost: custom 3D-printed titanium head-fixation bar, attached with dental acrylic
parameters.dreadd_cohort_variant: no craniotomy performed; headpost attached immediately after viral injection surgery instead

pipeline_steps.technique: Head-fixed virtual-reality treadmill training with progressive reward-zone shaping

parameters.apparatus: running wheel driving position on 5 surrounding LCD monitors displaying VR cues
parameters.water_restriction: at least 80% of pre-restriction body weight
parameters.shaping: reward across entire track initially, narrowed to a single fixed 20 cm reward zone
parameters.reward_duration_shaping: 10-15 s initially, reduced as animals learned the task, down to 2 s at proficiency
parameters.proficiency_criterion: >=50 laps in 20 minutes at 2 s reward duration
parameters.track: 400 cm VR environments with start/end tunnels and a 2 s inter-lap timeout with cues darkened

pipeline_steps.technique: VR Navigation task comparing cue-off and cue-on blocks with a fixed reward zone

parameters.vr_off_block: 25 laps with only the reward zone as a spatial cue, fixed at 360 cm
parameters.vr_on_block: subsequent 25 laps with visual cues restored, same fixed reward location
parameters.excluded_data: trailing VR-Off block after VR-On excluded from analysis except the lap-by-lap correlation plot

pipeline_steps.technique: Reward Alternation task switching between two fixed reward zones in blocks

parameters.reward_zones: RZ1 at 360 cm, RZ2 at 110 cm on the virtual track
parameters.block_structure: 10 laps at RZ1, 10 at RZ2, 10 at RZ1, 10 at RZ2
parameters.cueing: no visual cue indicating which reward zone was active

pipeline_steps.technique: Novel Reward Learning task with chemogenetic DREADD inactivation of EC-to-CA1 projections via DCZ

parameters.task: 6 m virtual environment, 3 novel reward locations per day (cued on first lap, then requiring licking), each location held 15 laps, 45 laps total
parameters.scoring: percentage of non-cued laps in which the animal successfully found the rewarded location
parameters.pharmacology: saline i.p. during training and the first 3 test days; 1 mg/kg DCZ i.p. (0.1 mg/mL in saline) on test day 4; 1 additional washout day

pipeline_steps.technique: Context Alternation task using two fully distinct visual-cue sets at a fixed reward location

parameters.block_structure: Context A for 10 laps, Context B for 10 laps, then A and B again for 10 laps each
parameters.reward_location: fixed at 360 cm for both contexts

pipeline_steps.technique: Random Foraging task with an optional multi-sensory (tone and odor) manipulation

parameters.task: novel VR environment, single reward location moved to a new position every lap, cued by an initial water drop
parameters.multisensory_manipulation: 5 kHz tone at 265 cm (20 cm zone) via a speaker; odor cue (carvone in mineral oil vs. mineral oil control) at 50 cm (10 cm zone) via a custom 3D-printed nose-cone with vacuum evacuation

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo two-photon imaging of EC axons in CA1 during VR behavior

parameters.laser: 920 nm (Coherent), 50-125 mW at the objective, power/alignment verified daily
parameters.objective: 16x Nikon water immersion (0.8 NA, 3.0 mm WD) at 3.5x digital zoom, FOV 240x240 um
parameters.detection: green (GCaMP6s) / red (tdTomato) split via HQ525/70m-2p and HQ607/45m-2p filters with 575dcxr dichroic, GaAsP PMTs (Hamamatsu 7422P-40), custom dual-stage preamp (1.4x10^5 dB, Bruker)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: raw two-photon GCaMP6s/tdTomato time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Motion correction using a modified NoRMCorre algorithm with corrupted-frame/patch rejection

parameters.algorithm: custom NoRMCorre implementation, modified to drop low-correlation patches or entire frames corrupted by z-motion (identified as outliers in the template correlation step)
parameters.quality_metric: frame stability reported in some cases as frame-to-time-average correlation

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected time series

pipeline_steps.technique: ROI detection, neuropil subtraction, and signal extraction for axonal boutons/segments via Suite2p

parameters.roi_definition: axon ROIs taken as individual boutons or small axon segments
parameters.quality_control: all ROIs visually inspected via the Suite2p interface to exclude spurious components

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-ROI raw fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: dF/F calculation with correlation-based merging of over-segmented axon ROIs

parameters.merging_criterion: Pearson pairwise correlation between dF/F traces of all ROI pairs in a FOV; pairs with r > 0.7 considered the same axon segment and merged

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: dF/F traces with merged axon-segment ROIs

pipeline_steps.technique: Calcium transient detection with iterative noise re-estimation and low-quality axon exclusion

parameters.onset_offset_thresholds: onset when dF/F surpasses 2 sigma (noise SD), offset when signal drops below 1 sigma; transient must reach 2.5 sigma and last >=1 s
parameters.iterative_reestimation: transients removed and sigma re-estimated iteratively to reduce skew from within-transient periods
parameters.exclusion_criteria: axons with <0.25 transients/min, or median within-transient max fluorescence <3.25 sigma or <0.35 dF/F, excluded from analysis

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected calcium transient events per axon ROI

pipeline_steps.technique: General hypothesis-testing conventions for group comparisons

parameters.unpaired_data: Welch's unequal-variances t-test (e.g. LEC vs. MEC comparisons)
parameters.multi_group: multi-factor ANOVA when more than two groups compared

pipeline_steps.technique: Classification of axons as spatially tuned via a shuffled spatial-information null distribution

parameters.metric: spatial information computed from Ca2+ transient onset times per ROI
parameters.null_distribution: circular shuffle of transient positions per lap, spatial information recomputed
parameters.significance_criterion: spatial information score above 95% of shuffles (p<0.05)
parameters.conditions_tested_separately: VR-On/VR-Off, RZ1/RZ2, Context A/Context B, and Visual-Only/Multi-Sensory foraging

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: calcium transient onset times aligned to position
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-axon spatially-tuned classification

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial field (place field) detection and boundary/width estimation for tuned axons

parameters.occupancy_normalized_tuning: computed for epochs with velocity >5 cm/s
parameters.candidate_field_criterion: tuning exceeding 95% of shuffled data for at least 4 cm
parameters.field_center_width: Gaussian fit to animal position at each transient event (center = distribution mean, width = 2 sigma)
parameters.minimum_activity: at least 3 Ca2+ transients within the field

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: place field center, width, and boundaries per axon per condition

pipeline_steps.technique: Position decoding from EC axon population activity using a multi-class support vector machine

parameters.binning: track split into 4 cm position bins as class labels
parameters.cross_validation: 2 laps held out and tested per fold, rotated across all laps
parameters.roi_counts: 1000 ROIs/FOV for VR navigation and random foraging; 900 for reward alternation; 750 for context change tasks (3 pseudo-random splits)
parameters.excluded_regions: 0-25 cm and 375-400 cm excluded (cues blocked by end tunnels)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded position estimates per time bin

pipeline_steps.technique: Running-speed decoding from axonal calcium activity using Lasso regression

parameters.model: Lasso regression on dF/F from a random subset of 1000 axonal ROIs per mouse

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded running speed per time bin

pipeline_steps.technique: Decoding of previous lap's context or reward zone from inter-lap axonal activity using a linear SVM

parameters.input_window: 2 s inter-lap timeout period (VR screens dark)
parameters.feature: Gaussian-smoothed (sigma=0.27 s) vector of Ca2+ transient onset times
parameters.train_test_split: trained on 36 laps, tested on 4 (one per context/reward-zone block)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded previous-lap context/reward-zone label

pipeline_steps.technique: Grid-cell-like tuning classification and 2D grid-lattice model fitting for spatially tuned axons

parameters.candidate_criteria: 5 criteria adapted from prior grid-classification work: >=2 spatial fields, transition count relative to track length and mean field width, widest field <5x mean width, >=30% of bins assignable in/out-of-field, in-field activity >=2x out-of-field activity
parameters.model_fit: 1D tuning curves fit to idealized linear slices through a 2D grid lattice (sum of three 2D sine waves), parameters (origin, period, angle) estimated via Fourier spectral peaks then refined by gradient-descent numerical optimization
parameters.control_comparison: LEC axons used as a non-grid control population

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: grid-like classification and fitted grid parameters (spacing, angle, phase) per axon

pipeline_steps.technique: Logistic regression model relating calcium transient probability to position, running, licking, reward, and time features

parameters.feature_groups: position (100 one-hot spatial bins), running (velocity, run start/stop, running vs. non-running), licking (binary lick events), reward (binary availability, start/stop events), time (lap time, experiment time, lap count)
parameters.lags: 0-1.6 s added to running features, +/-1.6 s to licking features
parameters.model_selection: leave-one-out cross-validation; models built up from single-feature-group to the full 5-variable model, retaining a group only if it significantly improved held-out log-likelihood over the mean-rate model (one-sided signed t-test, p=0.05)
parameters.task_specific_features: distance-to-reward feature for reward/context alternation tasks; separate position variables per context in the context alternation task

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-axon calcium transient times and behavioral feature traces
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-axon feature-group model assignment and fitted logistic regression weights

papers.title: behaviorMate: An Intranet of Things Approach for Adaptable Control of Behavioral and Navigation-Based Experiments.

pipeline_steps.technique: behaviorMate PC-based user interface software: event-driven control application implementing a Context/Context-List stimulus-scheduling architecture, JSON/UDP messaging to hardware components, and time-stamped experiment data logging

parameters.architecture: event-driven main loop over enabled Contexts; setup, main-loop, and termination phases
parameters.versions: long-term-support (LTS) release plus a streamlined JavaFX beta rewrite
parameters.configuration: user-generated JSON settings files (manual or script-generated)
parameters.logging: time-stamped streaming text file of hardware state for offline analysis
parameters.host: Intel NUC mini PC, i5-1135G7, 16GB RAM, Windows 10

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behaviorMate UI software controlling and logging behavioral experiments

pipeline_steps.technique: GPIO/Behavior Controller firmware: Arduino-based JSON-routed action-message architecture for reward/cue device control and TTL synchronization with imaging or electrophysiology hardware

parameters.messaging: JSON-formatted 'action'/'route' message protocol, human-readable and simulatable on the PC for debugging
parameters.io: 13 digital / 5 analog I/O connectors for sensors and actuators, Ethernet adapter for LAN communication
parameters.synchronization: bidirectional TTL trigger (3.3 V) generation/reception for microscope or other recording-device sync

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: firmware controlling reward/cue devices and generating synchronization triggers
